method.units: Draft Area-A headers compared with the engine's function_data: every draft unit is an engine unit, and every engine-only unit was checked to be an Area-B continuation line (gitgalaxy#3197), so the list was confirmed by two independent readings plus the source.
method.dead: Every dead verdict checked: no other mention of the name anywhere in the program's code, and the unit before it ends in an unconditional EXEC CICS RETURN/ABEND, GOBACK or a PERFORM of a section that never returns (or it sits inside an unreferenced section). The draft does not count a unit as dead unless it is dead with AND without main-flow fall-through across section boundaries (0 units depend on that choice). Sections named in EXEC CICS HANDLE ABEND/CONDITION/AID LABEL(...) are live (8 CBSA abend handlers).
method.live: Each live unit carries a reached-by path in the draft report (entry, PERFORM, GO TO, fall-through, CICS HANDLE label); a sample of those paths was checked against the source.
method.copybooks: COPY and EXEC SQL INCLUDE statements, resolved to .cpy/.copy members only (never a program). zopeneditor resolves through its zapp.yaml libraries (syslib, and IN MYFILE / IN MYLIB). Unresolved entries say why: CICS-, LE- or DB2-supplied, or a BMS-generated symbolic map.
method.files: SELECT ... ASSIGN plus every OPEN, splitting a multi-mode OPEN at each INPUT/OUTPUT/I-O/EXTEND keyword; checked against the source.
method.calls: CALL and EXEC CICS LINK/XCTL PROGRAM(...): literals as written, identifiers through their working-storage VALUE clause; resolved to the program with that PROGRAM-ID (nearest when shared). CEE* targets are LE callable services.
method.cics_sql: Presence of EXEC CICS / EXEC SQL in code lines; agrees with the forge's booleans on every program.
